podcast.title: Continued Friendship
podcast.body: Despite ending their musical collaboration in 1950, Knight and Tharp remained close, with Knight overseeing Tharp's funeral in 1973. "They stopped working together in 1950, but remained close enough that Knight was in charge of Tharp's funeral in 1973."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 5: "This Train" by Sister Rosetta Tharpe

podcast.title: Gospel Singing Partner
podcast.body: Marie Knight was a gospel singer who formed a successful double act with Sister Rosetta Tharp, creating a unique gospel sound. "Shortly after this, Tharp started working with another gospel singer Marie Knight."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 5: "This Train" by Sister Rosetta Tharpe

podcast.title: Open Secret Relationship
podcast.body: Their partnership was widely regarded as an "open secret" romantic relationship within the gospel music community, which was more tolerant of homosexuality/bisexuality. Knight, however, denied the relationship throughout her life, likely due to her conservative church devotion and career dependence on it. They stopped working together in 1950, but Knight handled Tharp's funeral in 1973. "Her partnership with Marie Knight may have been a partnership in more than one sense."
